title: Beyond Outdoors
description: A spiritual successor to Just Outdoor Stuffs mod. This mod was redesigned from ground up to include more variety of outdoor decorations and furniture supported for modern versions of Minecraft
body: ![Beyond Outdoors Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3ef47632e5182e13a6eeab2a34e732b2d570c94e_0.webp) ### ⭐ ABOUT: This mod is a spiritual successor to _Just Outdoor Stuffs_ — Completely made from ground up to provide more variety of outdoor decors and furniture!! Minecraft has always been lacking outdoor decorations so this mod was made to fill in those gaps!! There are currently 100 different decors/furniture within 5 different sets! Many more will be added in the future~ *** ### ❓ What can you expect from this mod compared to the old one? | 🔄 **Changeable Decors** **!!!** _Right-click on them to change how they look!!_ ![Changeable](https://i.imgur.com/M6F0il0.png) ⏫ **Stackable Decors** **!!!** _Lovely variety to spice up your build ambiance!!_ ![Stackable](https://i.imgur.com/Bidmk24.png) 🌈 **Dyeable** Decors **!!!** _Right-click with their respective dyes to change the colours!!_ ![Dyeable](https://i.imgur.com/bgsvmai.png) Last but not least… 🍃 **Bringing back some of the old classic garden decorations from Just Outdoor Stuffs!!** ![JOS](https://i.imgur.com/SUnihPM.png) Just like the old mod, you can obtain these decors by crafting their respective Blueprints and placing them in the _**Stonecutter**_ ![recipe](https://i.imgur.com/qVvHu9D.png) *** Enjoy my works?
